## Summary

Describe the problem and the selected change.

## Selection provenance

List source branches and commit hashes. State which competing ideas were
accepted or rejected and why.

## Physics and numerics

State affected equations, frames, units, assumptions, and validation evidence.
Write ?not applicable? only when no physics or numerical behavior changed.

## Checks

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] Analytic/reference validation completed where applicable
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `mypy`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `README.md`, `PHYSICS.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `PLAN.md`, and
      `CHANGES.md` updated as applicable
- [ ] No generated results, secrets, or unrelated changes included
